designs.title: Seed retained after dimensional CAD failures
designs.change: No geometry changes accepted. Two span/spar revisions and one narrower, lighter body revision all failed solid validation at root_fairing-1; each failure left the seed unchanged. Retain the seed with fixed airfoils and shape controls. Its supplied estimates are 70.85 km range, 19.0 m/s maximum speed, and 0.816 kg payload capacity; no new performance result was generated.

reflection.lesson: The same root_fairing-1 solid-validation failure occurred for both wing and body dimensional edits. These rejected candidates provide no evidence of aerodynamic or structural improvement, and no range gain can be claimed. Preserve the last valid geometry rather than treating failed edits as accepted designs.
reflection.next_focus: Diagnose root-fairing CAD robustness with airfoil and shape controls fixed, then retry a modest span increase with matched spar stiffness. designs.title: Cruise-targeted CST wing with increased span
designs.change: Optimized root and tip CST sections at Reynolds 220,000 and CL 0.65, achieving previewed 12.50% thickness and 2.74% camber. Increased span from 2.30 to 2.50 m, mid-chord factor to 1.04, and mid-span twist offset to +0.20 degrees. Reinforced the spar to 31 mm diameter with 1.0 mm wall. Retained battery, payload accommodation, enclosed body, four lift rotors, and cruise propeller.

reflection.lesson: The section optimizer converged with modeled mean Cd 0.00988 at its target condition; this is section performance, not a measured whole-aircraft range gain. The edited STEP preview succeeded with 32 valid solids and section thickness/camber within bounds. Increased span requires structural reinforcement rather than assuming the baseline spar remains adequate.
reflection.next_focus: Evaluate coupled cruise range at 150 Wh and 0.5 kg payload, checking at least 18.05 m/s maximum speed and 0.7752 kg payload capacity. Confirm spar containment, structural and stability margins, and adverse-case performance before further optimization or flight testing.

Removing sweep can move the neutral point forward; CAD validity alone does not establish acceptable static margin or cruise performance.

reflection.lesson: Section analysis at Re 200,000 and alpha 3 deg gives root CL/CD 0.60155/0.01059 and tip 0.71894/0.01043. The optimized tip carries more lift at equal incidence, motivating extra washout and mid-span loading adjustment; this is not proof of improved whole-aircraft range. The edited preview has 32 valid solids, sampled thickness 12.01–12.50% and camber 1.92–2.74%. Preserve the baseline root: iteration 2 failed root-fairing attachment checks, whereas iteration 3 passed. Increasing wall thickness inward avoids enlarging the spar envelope, but containment still requires checking in the reshaped wing.
reflection.next_focus: Evaluate coupled range at 150 Wh and 0.5 kg payload against iteration 3's 72.41 km and the seed's 70.85 km. Require maximum speed >=18.05 m/s and payload capacity >=0.7752 kg. Verify root-fairing attachments, spar containment, stress, <=0.0625 m tip deflection, static margin 0.05–0.20 and rotor clearance.
